title: zipnative AI Governance Configuration
description: Machine-readable contract governing how AI coding agents may propose issues, contributions, and changes across the zipnative family. Agents that scan repository configuration on initialization MUST honour this file. See .github/AGENT_RULES.md for the human-and-agent-readable protocol.

human_in_the_loop.role_of_human: reviewer and sole performer of GitHub writes
human_in_the_loop.gate: A human MUST explicitly review, sign off on, and trigger any GitHub issue, comment, PR, or release. The agent's authority ends at producing a local draft plus a compliance report.
human_in_the_loop.identity_integrity: Any issue or PR is published under the human user's GitHub identity. The agent MUST remind the user of their shared responsibility for the content before submission.

pre_issue_checklist: no_anti_goal_proposed (encryption in 1.x, other formats, multi-disk, fs-in-engine, repair, sockets, eval)

compliance_report.description: The structured summary an agent MUST present to the user alongside every draft and every AI-drafted pull request.

capability_manifest.description: Authoritative project context an agent SHOULD load before proposing changes.
capability_manifest.$comment: on_demand: load lazily by topic. sources are loaded on every task and verify-docs (governance-sources) holds their total under 16 KiB; ecosystem.json is the counts manifest, needed only when a figure or version is touched.

claude_code.description: How the policy is enforced inside a Claude Code session (settings, hook, rules, skills); verify-docs rules agent-config-parity, claude-rules-sync, claude-rules-budget and skills-shape keep these files consistent.

hooks.scope: whole command, every shell segment, $( ) and backtick bodies, sh/bash/zsh -c, pwsh/powershell -Command, node -e and npx -c payloads; fails closed on unreadable input

claude_code.permissions_deny: Read on generated and bulk files (dist/**, coverage/**, test-output/**, node_modules/**, package-lock.json, tests/fixtures/**, docs/llms-full.txt, docs/llms-recipes.txt, docs/llms-index.json, docs/assets/*.png) and Bash on the HITL commands above

rules.scoped: every rule carries paths: (the source applyTo); none loads unconditionally
